results.corrected_extracted: Pesticides: myclobutanil was quantified in 22 fluids (up to 28.3 micrograms per gram), the pesticide synergist piperonyl butoxide in 18 (up to 24.1), and several other fungicides, insecticides and acaricides above 1 microgram per gram in 25; 31 of the 36 cannabinoid-containing fluids held at least one (editors' count). The authors judge the pattern intermittent and random, and say it would suggest that EVALI is not due to exposure to a single pesticide. No mycotoxins (below 4.8 ng/g) and no synthetic cannabinoids or opioids (below 0.05% by mass) in any fluid.
